lines.text: The writer has not yet taken hold of it, so he forgets what is behind and presses toward the prize.
God will reveal it to those who think differently, but all must live up to what they have attained.
Paul tells them to follow his example, and says with tears that many live as students of the cross.
Their minds are set on earthly things, but our citizenship is in heaven, and we await the prophet Elijah.
Christ will transform our lowly bodies to be like His glorious body, so stand firm in the Lord.
